summary.h3: Are HummingBeing workshops in person or online?

div.p: Both. Several workshops run live online in Singapore time, such as Breath as Medicine and The Art of Conscious Rest, and TRE™ Module 1 is also offered online with TRE Scotland in UK time. In-person events take place in Singapore and Lisboa, Portugal, including Introduction to TRE™ and the 2027 certification cohorts.

summary.h3: Which event should I start with if I am new to TRE™?

div.p: Introduction to TRE™ is an in-person, two-hour workshop in Singapore for the general public, held with TRE Thailand on 23 February, 29 June and 3 November 2027. If you cannot travel, book a free discovery call and Isabelle will help you find the right starting point, including online sessions.
